So I made the foolish mistake of buying a MTB that I was never gonna ride out of the city. Now I want to change the tire to make it more suitable as a road bike. How do you feel about a 1.25" tire on a mountain bike? Anything I should be worried about?
Is a tire change from 26x1.95 to 26x1.25 on a MTB recommended?
I went from a 2.0" to a 1.25" for my daily commuter MTB and couldn't have been happier! The ride might not be as smooth and you might need different tubes. Other than that, go for it.
Thanks! That's a confidence boost. Do you have any problem with pinch flats?

Nope! I was running Schwalbe Marathon Plus tires and I have a habit of pumping my tires up to max pressure each morning. Pinch flats should only be a problem if you let your tires get low on pressure regardless of thickness.
It's not going to cause any mechanical issues, no, but you may want to try going for 1.5 instead of 1.25, they're a nice in-between size.
I put some 'City Slickers' on my MTB, road tread on a 1.25 tyre. Not sure if they still make them but I am sure there is something similar on the market
I'd say go for it - or even better, get a road bike!
I would recommend just getting slick road style tires, that will help more then just getting skinnier tires.

Check your rim width. It should be fine, but there are some uber wide rims out there where a 1.25 might not seat in the clincher grooves very well and might be susceptible to flats.
